name: Farrowing
flow: tap a miscarriage / not in pig / removed row
Finish farrowing while an Edit draft waits
Save, or Back, when opened from Finish
Save, or Back, when opened from the locked record
Save, when opened from the blocked Finish
Back with the draft kept, when opened from the blocked Finish
Save, or Back, on a sow that died
End task early (sows still farrowing or unsaved)
tap the still-farrowing warning, then a sow
tap the will-be-removed warning, then a sow
tap an outcome, then a miscarriage sow
tap Sow deaths, then a sow

notes.purpose: The task's home: pick the next sow in one unit, read the unit's litter size and the whole task's progress, and jump by pen, ear tag or search.
states: Empty list: "No awaiting sows" / "No matching sows" with a hint ("Adjust the filters…" when a filter is on, else "Choose another status…")
Task already ended: the room is replaced by the Today card "Task ended · N finished / View receipt"
Unit switched from the Task overview: scroll position and current pen are kept per unit, and reset when the lens or filter changed meanwhile

elements.name: Sow row
elements.shows: One line per task sow, grouped under her pen: ear tag, state chip, two text lines, rail icon.

states.when: No live total (alive + dead = 0), not finished, no outcome. Due text begins "Due tomorrow" or "Due in N days"
states.shows: No chip. Line 1 "Due tomorrow" / "Due in 2 days" (muted). Line 2 "parity 5 · 11 born last" (12 when unknown). Chevron.

states.when: Same, due text "Due today" or "Due yesterday"
states.shows: Line 1 "Due today" in ink (not muted). Line 2 as above. Chevron.

states.when: Due text begins "Overdue" (expected date = service + 114 days; overdue from day 116)
states.shows: Line 1 "Overdue · 3 days": only "3 days" is red, the word stays ink. Line 2 as above.

states.when: Live total above zero and not finished
states.shows: Green "Active" chip. Line 1 "9 alive · 5 dead". Line 2 "born 14 · 1h ago · G.H" ("just now" after a tap in this session). Chevron. No overdue colour once she has a record.
Grey "Done" chip. Line 1 alive · dead as now (alive falls when later deaths are recorded). Line 2 "born 14 · final 05:58 · G.H". Pencil icon: locked but editable.

states.when: Farrowing ended through the sow's death
states.shows: Red "Sow died" chip instead of Done. Same two lines; line 2 "born 10 · yesterday · L.M". Pencil. Counts under the Done tab.

states.when: Miscarriage, Not in pig or Removed from batch recorded
states.shows: No chip. Line 1 the outcome name; line 2 "Recorded · 08:10 · G.H". Chevron; opens the Production log. Counts under Done.

elements.logic: Days are counted from due, never the gestation day. Awaiting vs Active flips on the live total: a sow counted back to zero reads Awaiting again and regains her Due line. Recency ("1h ago") and hand ("G.H") are fixed sample text, not computed from records.

elements.name: Unit card
elements.shows: The left half of the context strip: unit name, one large figure, its label and a target line.

states.when: The figure is below the target (the card's belowTarget flag)
states.shows: "Target 12" in amber text

states.when: The figure meets or beats the target
states.shows: "Target 12" in the normal support colour

elements.rule: Confirmed by the owner: Target is an amber below-target warning. It is amber when the unit's live-per-litter is below the target and neutral otherwise.
elements.logic: Figure = the unit's average live piglets per litter ("Live / litter"); target = its per-litter target. Not editable; the unit changes only through the Task overview or Home's Choose unit.

elements.name: Task overview card
elements.shows: The right half of the strip, one button that opens the Task overview: heading, number, label, three-colour bar, support line.

states.shows: "7 / 18 · Farrowed · all units" with support "2 active · 9 awaiting"
That segment is left out of the bar; the number and support text still print the zero

states.when: Sows with miscarriage, not in pig or removed, or that died before or during farrowing
states.shows: Counted in neither the number nor the denominator, so they leave the bar entirely

elements.logic: Numerator Farrowed = finished litters in all units, excluding outcomes and sows that died before or during farrowing (a sow that died after finishing stays counted). Denominator = Farrowed + Active + Awaiting. Segment widths are proportional to those counts. Scope is all units and never follows the lens or filter.

elements.name: Last record line
elements.shows: "Last record 08:41 · G. Hansen" under the app bar.
elements.logic: Meant to be the newest record time and hand in the unit. In the prototype it is fixed text: 08:41, or 09:41 once any sow carries the 09:41 stamp a live tap writes; the hand is always G. Hansen.

elements.name: State tabs
elements.shows: Awaiting · Active · Done · All, each with a count; All is the default.

states.shows: Counts for the whole current unit, e.g. Awaiting 4 · Active 1 · Done 2 · All 7

states.when: Due or parity filter is on
states.shows: Every count shrinks to the filtered sows
Tab stays, shows 0; the list shows the empty state

elements.logic: Counts are for the current unit only (not all units) and follow the filter, not the other tab. Done = finished litters, sows that died and sows with a recorded outcome. Selecting a tab resets the scroll to the top.

elements.name: Filter
elements.shows: Funnel button beside the tabs; opens the Filter sows sheet (due range, parity).

states.when: Due range 7+ days ago … in 7+ days and parity Any
states.shows: Plain funnel, no summary line
Count badge on the funnel (0–2 filters) and a line under the tabs "Due: Today – In 2 days · Parity 2–5" with Clear

elements.rule: Apply keeps the filter until Clear; Clear removes both filters at once. The due range matches each sow's stored due text, so it also hides Active and Done sows by a date that no longer matters to them.

elements.name: Pen header
elements.shows: Pen code, sow count, chevron (opens the pen sheet), and "N shown" when rows are hidden.

states.when: Lens All and no filter, or every sow in the pen passes
states.shows: "B4 · 3 sows" ("1 sow" for one)

states.when: The lens or filter hides some of the pen's sows
states.shows: Count unchanged plus "2 shown" beside it

states.when: No sow of the pen passes
states.shows: Pen is not listed at all

elements.logic: The sow count is the pen's full task total, ignoring lens and filter. Pens are ordered alphanumerically.

elements.name: Dock
elements.shows: Go to pen (left), Scan ear tag (primary), Search (icon only).

states.shows: Shows the pen at the top of the list under the sticky bar; follows scroll live and updates after a jump or after opening a sow. "Pens" when none.

states.when: Each A–D × 1–6 pen in the Go to pen sheet
states.shows: One-word fact: "Active" / "2 active"; else "Overdue" / "2 overdue"; else "N born ✓" when all finished; else "Due today" or the first due text; "No matches" (pen has sows, none pass the view, disabled); "Not in task" (disabled)

elements.rule: Pen map: tap jumps to the pen and highlights it for 0.9 s; hold 0.35 s peeks at its sows. The tab bar and filter line stay stuck at the top while the list scrolls. Scan ear tag has no camera in the prototype ("Try sample tag" opens the first sow) and also holds the ear-tag text search.
elements.source: farrowing-astra-concept.js room() dock, penFact(), roomAfterRender(), scroll handler

controls.does: opens a Pen sheet (not a separate screen): notices, Feed guidance, Report equipment fault, Add/Edit pen note, Pen log
opens "Find a sow": ear tag or pen text with live "N sows found"; a result opens like a row

(raw) Due today · Due tomorrow · Due in N days · Due yesterday · Overdue · N days
(raw) Go to pen · Scan ear tag · Search ear tag
(raw) No awaiting sows · No matching sows

Filter that hides every sow: empty state with the filter hint; Clear or Reset recovers
rules: "Rows speak in days from due, never gestation day" (Model)
"Every litter row carries its three numbers … alive · dead on line 1, born on line 2" (Model)
"No staleness tracking on Active sows" / interval chip retired (Model)

issues: Unit card and tabs are Unit 7 only; the Task overview card is all units. Only the card names its scope.
Active and Awaiting appear three times at two scopes: bar segments, support text and tabs.
"Done 2" and "Farrowed 7" look like one measure but count differently; neither label explains it.
Prototype hard-codes amber (belowTarget = true); never shows the neutral state.
Row recency and hand are hard-coded; "1h ago" never ticks. Overdue rows lack the ruled "induced yesterday · L.M" second line.
Last record line repeats each row's recency; the ruled one-sentence task copy under it is missing.
Pen headers open pen tools (feed, fault, note, log) although the rulings call them census-only dead zones; unclear whose feature that is.
Two search doors: the magnifier and the text search inside Scan ear tag.
Entry mismatch: Home's whole-farm card is meant to land here but opens the Task overview sheet over it first.

notes.purpose: Keep the live count while she farrows: one big Alive number whose + and − save at once, with the litter so far.
states: Edit draft waiting (kept with Back): Finish farrowing stays enabled but opens the blocked Finish sheet
Visit with nothing changed: receipt reads just "Saved"

elements.name: Alive stepper
elements.shows: Large − and + keys around the Alive number (not typeable).

states.when: Alive is more than anchor − dead recorded
states.shows: − and + both live; each tap changes Alive and the open visit and is saved at once
− is greyed (aria-disabled); a tap writes nothing and shows the pointer text for 4 s in place of the receipt
Number is grey; she reads as Before first count

elements.logic: Alive = posted + this visit. + is always allowed; the first + makes an Awaiting sow Active. Recording a death lowers the floor, so − becomes possible again. Counting down to zero makes her Awaiting again.

elements.name: Receipt
elements.shows: Status line under the number.

states.shows: "Saved"
"Saved · +4 this visit"
"Saved · 2 died this visit"

states.when: A greyed − was tapped, for 4 s
states.shows: "Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections."

elements.logic: The visit folds into one log line ("+4 alive") when the sheet is left by any exit.

elements.name: Litter summary
elements.shows: Born and Dead figures, the causes line and View log.

states.shows: One chip per type with a non-zero count: Stillborn 1 · Mummified 1 · Crushed 2 · Other 1
Causes line is hidden

states.when: Nothing recorded and no pending count
states.shows: View log is disabled

elements.logic: Born = Alive + all dead (derived, never typed). Dead = sum of the six types.

elements.name: Edit · Record death
elements.shows: Two of the three quick actions (the third is More actions).

states.when: Nothing posted: no events and Born is 0
states.shows: Greyed
Small "Unsaved" under the label (cannot occur today because leaving the drawer clears the draft)

elements.name: Finish farrowing
elements.shows: Primary button in the bar.

states.shows: Greyed
Opens the Finish sheet; opens the blocked version if an Edit draft is waiting

controls.does: each tap is saved at once; − at the floor is refused with the pointer text
all four leave to the room list and fold the visit into one log line

copy: (raw) Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections.
edge: Leaving by any exit folds the visit; reopening shows the folded total
An Edit draft kept with Back is not lost; Finish then opens blocked

states: Counted back to zero later: reads this state again, but View log and Edit stay available if events exist

elements.name: Header state line
elements.shows: The status word after the pen and parity.

states.when: No live total, expected date ahead or today
states.shows: "Due today" / "Due tomorrow" / "Due in 2 days" (the room's Due line without the day number)
"Overdue · 3 days"

states.when: After the first + or first death
states.shows: "Farrowing", on the same sheet

elements.name: Alive and receipt
elements.shows: Grey 0, then the line "Tap + as piglets are born".
elements.logic: − is greyed, + is live. The receipt line shows only while there are no events and Alive is 0; the first tap turns it into "Saved · +1 this visit". Opening and leaving without a tap writes nothing.
elements.rule: The first + (or first death) is the start of farrowing; there is no separate start action.

elements.name: Unavailable controls
elements.shows: What is greyed while nothing is recorded.

states.shows: Disabled
Disabled
Disabled

notes.purpose: The one dead drawer: tally piglets born dead or died by type, or record the sow's own death.
states: Photo dialog over the drawer (tap a thumbnail): Back, Delete
Opened from Before first count, Finish, the locked record or the ended record: same drawer, returns to where it was opened

elements.name: Dead header
elements.shows: "Dead 6" with "Born dead or died · 1 unsaved" and Clear.

states.shows: "Dead 5" (saved total); no unsaved count; Clear and Save disabled
"Dead 6" (saved + draft); "1 unsaved" in green; Clear live

elements.name: Type rows
elements.shows: Stillborn · Mummified · Crushed · Scours · Starve-out · Other, each with − n +.

states.shows: + has no limit; deaths raise Born, never Alive
+ stops when drafted deaths equal Alive now; saving lowers Alive now

elements.name: Piglets | The sow
elements.shows: Two-way segment at the top.

states.shows: Piglets and The sow
The sow segment is not offered

elements.name: The sow

states.shows: Save disabled

states.shows: Band adds "Save or clear the pending piglet deaths / correction before ending" with Review; Save disabled
Save enabled; "Other" adds an optional details line

elements.shows: Optional photos with a camera button and thumbnails.

elements.name: Piglet condition

elements.rule: Each tap saves at once. Weak + deformed cannot exceed Alive (the + greys out). Healthy has no row; it is Alive − weak − deformed and prints on the record.

elements.name: Optional facts

states.shows: Button label only

Assistance returns to "Not recorded"

states.when: Born above zero and no draft waiting
states.shows: Hold 0.85 s
